pages.summary: Malcolm descubrió que el encantamiento seguía en el maletero. Pansy presenta a Robin una Snitch pequeña con encantamientos de localización.

panels.scene: Malcolm in glowing reindeer sweater smiles by the low table, wristwatch new. Hermione in red is caught off guard, at left, Pansy at edge amused. Two balloons from Hermione then Malcolm.
dialogue: Hermione: ¿Cómo lo supiste?
Malcolm: La capacidad del compartimento se triplicó.

panels.scene: Hermione insists from left, Malcolm at right gives a dry calm reply. Pansy green remains nearby, no image of car needed.
dialogue: Hermione: ¡Quité el hechizo!
Malcolm: Sigue ahí.

panels.scene: Pansy lifts ONE natural hand as Hermione gives her an accusing look; both still in Christmas sweaters, fine bracelet on Pansy's LEFT wrist.
dialogue: Pansy: Yo prometí no decirle nada y cumplí.

panels.scene: Pansy sits on rug close to one human Robin in burgundy and cream with separate blue elephant in his lap. She opens a small plain gift box on rug, dark green foam inside, while Hermione sits nearby.
panels.caption: El siguiente regalo pertenecía a Robin.

panels.scene: Close Pansy holds a SMALL gold Snitch ball with two delicate silver-gold wings in one palm, checking it with her other hand holding a short wand. Fine bracelet on her left wrist, no rings. Wings separate from her two hands.
panels.caption: Pansy revisó por última vez los encantamientos.

panels.scene: Small golden winged toy floats gently in front of Robin at a comfortable distance. Pansy's supporting hand behind his back; he reaches with one tiny natural hand, blue elephant separate on lap. Hermione watches attentively.
dialogue: Pansy: También funciona como localizador.

pages.summary: La Snitch es de las dos madres. Pansy sostiene a Robin mientras intenta alcanzarla y Crookshanks calcula cómo cazar el nuevo juguete.

panels.scene: Hermione sits to the LEFT of Pansy on rug beside child, smiles admiringly toward the small Snitch. Pansy green at right, Robin between them supported.
dialogue: Hermione: Pensaste en todo.

panels.scene: Pansy meets Hermione's eyes, one hand supports baby's back and the other rests on her own lap, bracelet at anatomical left.
dialogue: Pansy: Pensamos. Es de parte de las dos.

panels.scene: Robin leans toward the slow Snitch, TWO natural hands in front, and Pansy places ONE hand across his little belly to support him. He remains seated on rug, toy wings separate from baby's fingers. Blue elephant beside his knee.
dialogue: Pansy: Con calma, cariño. No tienes que atraparla esta noche.

panels.scene: Crookshanks crouches on his own rust chair, yellow eyes follow the distant small gold toy. Red velvet bow and gold bell distinct. Pansy's voice comes clearly from offscreen left, no figure added.
dialogue: Pansy: Ni se te ocurra.

panels.scene: Hermione smiles looking from cat to Robin, safely supported by Pansy beside her. Baby is a human infant, holds blue elephant again.
dialogue: Hermione: Creo que acabas de asegurar que nunca pierda de vista a Robin.

panels.scene: Pansy looks at cat then toward child with mock confidence, same left bracelet, Hermione rests head lightly on her shoulder for a moment.
dialogue: Pansy: Voy a fingir que esa medida de seguridad también formaba parte del diseño.

pages.summary: Solo queda una caja de terciopelo verde. Pansy presenta el anillo y aclara ante los Granger el sentido de su regalo.

panels.scene: Pansy has picked up the LAST small closed DARK GREEN velvet jewelry box, nervous smile becoming earnest. Hermione sits back on olive sofa with Robin close to her on rug. No ring yet on Hermione.
panels.caption: Solo quedaba una caja.

panels.scene: Pansy sits on EDGE of low oak coffee table facing Hermione on sofa, fully clothed, feet on rug, box in her two hands. Jane and Malcolm in separate rust chairs exchange a look, Malcolm straightens.
panels.caption: Malcolm reconoció la forma antes de que se abriera.

panels.scene: Macro open dark green velvet box containing ONE delicate ring: CLEAR COLORLESS OVAL DIAMOND, small clear diamond halo, fine white-metal band. Christmas light reflections, no blue gemstone (blue sapphire stays on Hermione's necklace).
panels.caption: El diamante atrapó la luz del árbol.

panels.scene: Pansy at left holds the open box and briefly glances toward Malcolm at right, who is clearly listening. One exact balloon from Pansy.
dialogue: Pansy: Antes de que alguien entre en pánico, no es un anillo de compromiso.

panels.scene: Malcolm gives visible relieved exhale and Jane gently nudges his covered upper arm with her elbow, amused reproach. Both mature faces and his glowing reindeer nose. No balloon.
panels.caption: Jane tuvo que darle un pequeño golpe con el codo.

panels.scene: Pansy returns her gaze to Hermione, box remains steady in her hands, fine left wrist bracelet visible. Hermione listens without interrupting.
dialogue: Pansy: En mi familia, las joyas solían entregarse para cerrar acuerdos.

pages.summary: Pansy cuenta la costumbre que rompieron sus padres y explica que mandó diseñar el anillo para Hermione como una promesa propia.

panels.scene: Pansy speaks quietly while seated at edge of coffee table. Hermione opposite on olive sofa. Same two faces and exact outfits, Pansy's gold barrette above LEFT ear.
dialogue: Pansy: Mis padres consideraron que era una tradición absurda.

panels.scene: Pansy open palm in a restrained natural gesture beside the open box resting on her lap, no one kneels, no ring on Hermione.
dialogue: Pansy: Me enseñaron que se entrega cuando estás dispuesto a prometer algo de verdad.

panels.scene: Close Pansy's anatomical LEFT wrist with FINE white-gold chain and three small H, R, P individual charms; her right thumb lightly touches the charms. Box on her fully clothed lap. One balloon from Pansy.
dialogue: Pansy: Mandé diseñarlo únicamente para ti.

panels.scene: Ring macro in open dark green box: one transparent oval diamond, clear halo, fine white band, no extra rings. Pansy's natural two fingertips near rim, not inside stone.
dialogue: Pansy: La piedra, el corte, cada detalle... todo fue escogido pensando en ti.

panels.scene: Pansy's angular face more vulnerable, green eyes toward Hermione, barrette tiny and left. No extra jewelry on ears.
dialogue: Pansy: La promesa es mía. Este anillo es la forma de hacerla tangible.

panels.scene: Hermione freckles and brown eyes filling with happy tears, listens with lips gently parted. Her blue sapphire and white platinum chain remain at front. Balloon clearly from off-frame Pansy at left.
dialogue: Pansy: Una familia es el lugar donde puedes bajar la guardia.

panels.scene: Wider intimate family room view, mothers face each other, human Robin beside Hermione with blue elephant, cat and two pups in distinct places, grandparents quietly listening from chairs.
dialogue: Pansy: Una cena, un árbol, una cafetera absurdamente fascinante...
